memory:
Plans a tropical dinner: spicy mango margaritas, pineapple-prosciutto skewers, shrimp ceviche, jerk chicken with mango salsa, sweet potatoes, and coconut-lime panna cotta with dessert mango salsa. Enjoys spicy/sweet mango, jerk seasoning on chicken, creamy desserts with tangy contrast. Cocktail clas

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- Cocktail-making class is on Friday according to the latest session; the earlier notes said Thursday.
- The user has experimented with basil in cocktails and with jerk seasoning.
- The user has previously made homemade margaritas with Avion Silver, one of their favorite tequilas.
- The dinner side changed from grilled asparagus and quinoa to roasted sweet potatoes.
- During the class, the user plans to experiment with Paloma and Tequila Sour cocktails.
- The user plans to make a Watermelon Basil Margarita, possibly with roasted watermelon and Avion Silver.
- The user enjoys tequila cocktails—especially margaritas—and likes watermelon, basil, lime, and tequila.
- S adds a dessert mango salsa to the coconut-lime panna cotta, but R states only coconut-lime panna cotta.
